title: A remediated valley
scene_prompt: World Shot. Cinematic documentary photograph of an Andean-Amazon foothill valley where a former mine site has been restored. We see a regraded slope planted with young native trees in neat rows, a clear river running below over clean gravel bars, intact green forest beyond, and soft morning mist lifting off the hills. Composition: the restored slope and river anchor the lower-right half of the frame; the upper-left half is open morning sky and mist over distant ridges, kept clear and uncluttered as a zone for a headline overlay. Elevated 25-degree view from the opposite slope, immersive, with a sense of scale. Lighting: early golden light catching the young trees and the river, cool blue-green in the valley shadows. Mood: optimistic, land that is healing, a river running clear again; end-state, not process. Shot on 35mm lens, f/4 aperture. Kodak Portra 800 film stock. Warm analog color palette, forest green (#0f4c3a) shadows in the forest, morning amber (#F4A261) highlights, river slate in the water. Fine organic film grain. Natural vignetting. Editorial documentary quality. The image feels like a frame from a film; the viewer is inside the world of mining remediation and feels optimistic about what they see. Full-bleed photograph: no grid lines, no composition guides, no frame border, no rounded corners, no film-edge markings. No machinery with markings, no signs. No typography, no logos, no words, no lettering of any kind, no identifiable human faces.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a, morning amber, river slate

title: Concession footprint compliance
scene_prompt: PERSPECTIVE: top-down tactical map view of a licensed mining concession in forested foothills. PHYSICAL LAYER: forested terrain as soft topographic relief in muted green tones, a river winding through, the cleared working area of the concession in warm amber tones. INTELLIGENCE LAYER: the license footprint outlined as a crisp glowing teal polygon; a fine change-detection grid over the area, with activity cells inside the footprint shown in a neutral muted tone and one cell just outside the footprint flagged in amber with a soft ring; two small inset swatches showing before and after for the flagged cell. HUD PANELS: two floating translucent dark panels with thin cyan borders: a compact compliance status tile and a small change-over-time bar glyph; all glyphs abstract, no readable text. SUBSTRATE: near-black slate (#0a0f14) with faint contour texture and forest green (#0f4c3a) undertones. LIGHTING: cyan emission from the lines and panels, amber glow only on the flagged elements, soft bloom where cyan meets the dark. TEXTURE: halftone dithered grain, subtle scan-line noise on panels, analog warmth over digital subject. Keep the upper-left quadrant quiet for a caption. No typography, no logos, no readable words, no faces.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a on dark, amber accent on the flagged cell
